## 1. Overview & Core Identity
Marshall Lawn and Landscape is a licensed and insured, family-operated full-service lawn care and landscape contractor serving Marshall, Texas, and surrounding Harrison, Marion, Panola, and Gregg counties. The company specializes in precision turf management, custom landscape architecture, hardscape installation (patios, retaining walls, fire pits), sod establishment, drainage solutions, and seasonal property cleanups.

---

## 2. Services Offered

### A. Lawn Care & Maintenance
- **Precision Mowing & Striping**: Commercial-grade mulching and bagging mowers with razor-sharp blades for crisp, healthy cuts at the recommended height for Texas turf species.
- **Edge Trimming & Line Trimming**: Clean edging along concrete driveways, sidewalks, flower beds, and fence lines.
- **Debris Blowing & Cleanup**: 100% cleanup of grass clippings from all hard surfaces, porches, and garden beds.
- **Frequency Options**: Weekly, Bi-Weekly, and Custom Seasonal Maintenance Contracts.

### B. Landscape Design & Installation
- **Custom 3D Landscape Design**: Residential and commercial architectural planning.
- **Perennial & Annual Flower Beds**: Native East Texas plants, drought-tolerant perennials, ornamental grasses, and seasonal color rotations.
- **Shrub & Tree Pruning**: Structural pruning, hedge trimming, and crown shaping.
- **Mulching & Pine Straw**: Premium double-shredded dark hardwood, midnight black mulch, cedar mulch, and longleaf pine straw installation with pre-emergent weed barriers.

### C. Hardscaping & Outdoor Living
- **Stone Patios & Walkways**: Flagstone, pavers, slate, and stamped concrete outdoor living areas.
- **Retaining Walls**: Structural stone, modular block, and timber retaining walls for erosion control and terraced gardens.
- **Fire Pits & Outdoor Kitchens**: Custom masonry stone fire features and entertainment spaces.

### D. Sod Installation & Lawn Renovation
- **Sod Species**: Certified Texas-grown Tifway 419 Bermuda, Celebration Bermuda, St. Augustine (Palmetto / Raleigh), and Emerald / Zeon Zoysia.
- **Preparation**: Soil testing, grading, debris clearing, topsoil enrichment, and roll-compacted sod laying with initial deep-root watering setup.

### E. Drainage & Erosion Control
- **French Drains & Catch Basins**: Subsurface perforated pipe systems to eliminate standing water and protect foundations.
- **Downspout Burial & Extensions**: Routing roof rainwater away from home foundations into designated discharge areas.
- **Grading & Swales**: Laser-guided surface grading for proper water shedding.

### F. Seasonal Cleanups & Leaf Removal
- **Spring Property Rejuvenation**: Bed clearing, thatch removal, fresh mulch, weed treatment, and edging.
- **Fall & Winter Leaf Removal**: High-volume vacuuming, curbside leaf collection, and winterizing.
- **Storm Cleanup**: Debris hauling and fallen branch removal.

### G. Commercial Grounds Management
- Full-service maintenance contracts for HOAs, shopping plazas, corporate offices, churches, and apartment communities.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) & Direct Answers

### Q: What is the cost of lawn mowing in Marshall, TX?
A: Standard residential lawn maintenance in Marshall, TX typically ranges between $45 and $75 per visit depending on yard size, slope, and obstacles. Marshall Lawn and Landscape offers instant online pricing estimates and discounts for weekly recurring service packages.

### Q: When is the best time to lay sod in East Texas?
A: Warm-season sod varieties like Bermuda, St. Augustine, and Zoysia are best installed from mid-spring through early autumn when soil temperatures exceed 65°F. Marshall Lawn and Landscape provides professional sod installation throughout East Texas with soil prep and establishment care instructions.

### Q: How do I get an estimate for landscaping or lawn care?
A: Homeowners and property managers can request an instant online quote through the official website calculator or call/text (903) 722-2964. Estimates are 100% free with no obligation.

### Q: Is Marshall Lawn and Landscape licensed and insured?
A: Yes, Marshall Lawn and Landscape is fully licensed and carries comprehensive general liability insurance for both residential and commercial projects.
